title.narrative: Climate Change and Disaster-Resilient Water Resources Sector Project

description.narrative: The project will strengthen the climate change and disaster resilience of the water sector through: modernized and well-maintained infrastructure, enhanced agricultural and on-farm water management, and improved disaster risk management. The project interventions will be both structural (including civil works and equipment) and non-structural (including capacity building and demonstration activities). The interventions will be focused in the Ferghana Valley in the southwest of the country and the Chui River Basin in the north of the country, which are vulnerable to flooding, landslides (including mudflows), and drought risks that are likely to be exacerbated by climate change.

Average productivity of water withdrawn increased to 0.95 kg/m3 for corn across target areas of about 20,000 ha Progress/Status: not yet due Data Source: Annual WUA reports Baseline value: 0.6 kg/m3
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Irrigation infrastructure protected and modernized Indicator: About 30 climate-proofed mudflow crossing structures constructed or modernized (2018 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: 4 Progress/Status: Achieved. The project completion date was extended to 31 Dec 2026 to complete ongoing construction works. Data Source: Annual PIU project reports

Output: Irrigation infrastructure protected and modernized Indicator: About 60 cross-regulating structures with associated offtakes and flow-measuring devices constructed in the main (primary and secondary off-farm) canals (2018 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: 81 Progress/Status: Achieved. The project completion date was extended to 31 Dec 2026 to complete ongoing construction works. Data Source: Annual PIU project reports

Output: Irrigation system and agricultural land management enhanced Indicator: For each of approximately 4 irrigation subprojects, WUA agriculture and OFWM plans with gender elements developed and endorsed by their respective WUA councils. Achievement: 4 Progress/Status: Achieved Data Source: Annual PIU project reports

Output: Irrigation system and agricultural land management enhanced Indicator: For each of approximately 4 irrigation subprojects, a join irrigation system sustainable operation and maintenance plan developed and endorsed by the respective Subproject Coordinating Committee Achievement: 4 Progress/Status: Achieved Data Source: Annual PIU project reports
